title: The simulation core at a glance
interpretation: One BioGears sepsis specification runs under three interchangeable engines (a C++ physiology engine, an exact SBML extraction, and a learned surrogate) by swapping a single node over shared typed ports — and that one model drives four runnable capabilities: composition, ensembles, orchestration, and performance.
